title: Vault: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object Signing and Encryption set of… (CVE-2026-116586)
description: A security vulnerability exists in the vault package's Go JOSE implementation, which handles Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. The flaw affects versions prior to 2.2.1-r1. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.9. A fix is available in version 2.2.1-r1.
